name: Staci Kitchens
why: No new crop. The archive already holds this portrait under 'Stacy Kitchens' at 1990-91, from the WKU Spirit Masters scrapbook for 1991-92 (UA12/2/16), where each member's picture carries a printed block giving name, hometown, class and major. What this pass adds is the proof that she and the 'Staci Kitchens' the archive lists separately at 1991-92 are the same woman, and that the archive's own doubt about the spelling can be closed. The 1991 Talisman, p. 185, prints the Associated Student Government group with a caption naming ten people, front row Emily G. Morgan, Maryann D'Aniello, Staci J. Kitchens, K. Ashley Means, Deanna L. Mills, and back row Ade, Bunce, Willoughby, Smith, Miller -- two women then three men, which the picture matches exactly, fixing the caption as left to right. The third figure in the front row is a dark-haired woman in a black sweater, and that is the same face as the Spirit Masters portrait: same parting, same features, same smile. So the Talisman spells her Staci, printed, in the very body the archive records her in.
caption_quote: Front: Emily G. Morgan, Maryann D'Aniello, Staci J. Kitchens
id_note: The archive's note on this person reads 'On the absence roll at 21 Jan 1992 only, OCR'd Sta t i Kitche ns. Read as Staci Kitchens, unverified.' The 1991 Talisman prints Staci J. Kitchens in type, so the reading is now verified. The Spirit Masters scrapbook spells it Stacy; the two archive entries, Stacy Kitchens at 1990-91 and Staci Kitchens at 1991-92, are one person, and the editor may want to merge them.

name: Pam Weils
why: 1991 Talisman, p. 184, the Associated Student Government group photograph.
